snippet.title: Pizza Slice | Steam Demo Announcement Trailer - Coming October 3rd
snippet.description:
Wishlist Pizza Slice Demo now at - https://cutt.ly/LrMD1M3G

Pizza Slice Demo is coming to Steam on October 3rd! In just a few days, you’ll jump straight into the cozy world of pizza-shaping, business-running, and client-serving, where every choice and every topping shapes the future of your very own Italian restaurant! Build your reputation one pizza at a time, experiment with unique recipes, and make your place the talk of the town. After the warm reception of the closed Steam Playtest, the Demo will be available to all willing chefs! For more information, head to the Pizza Slice Steam page.

–

Join us on Discord - https://discord.gg/FyjMUxK3gd

More about Pizza Slice Demo - https://cutt.ly/ZrMDnPQL
